name: Card Counter
body:
Your skills at deck manipulation are unmatched.

Card Shift (Ex)

At 1st level, as a swift action, you can look at the top three cards in your deck. You can arrange those three cards as you choose.

Cut the Deck (Ex)

At 6th level, when you look at the top three cards in your deck, you may move any or all of them to the bottom of the deck. You cannot use this ability on that deck again until you shuffle the deck.

Split the Deck (Ex)

At 11th level, if you have at least 10 cards in your deck, as a bonus action you may split your deck into two smaller decks, called split decks.

Each split deck must have at least five cards after the split. You can use your card counter abilities on either split deck, though each use affects only a single deck.

Any effect that causes you to shuffle your deck returns the two split decks into a single deck. You cannot split a split deck.

Greater Card Shift (Ex)

At 18th level, you can look at the top 5 cards in your deck instead of only the top 3.

This also works for cut the deck and split the deck.
